compatibility_decision: additive only on V1-frozen symbols; new fields serialized only when informative (2026-09-16, repository owner)
strictness_decision: 2026-09-16, repository owner: undeclared or unbound information LOWERS the claim for comparison and prediction; independence of measurement errors is RECORDED and does not lower a claim, because the data cannot establish it
what_was_already_seen: the audit reproductions only: E9 (a linearized prediction at x = 1e4 from a calibration over x in [0, 1], SUPPORTED; an unrelated predictor in kelvin, SUPPORTED), A1/A2 (a held-out point inside the posterior's conditioning set accepted; a comparison of two identical models won by +0.95 nats through that leak), A3 (preferred_model named for a 1.5e-9 nat difference on one observation)

decisive_comparison.statistic: paired differences d_i = lpd_a,i - lpd_b,i over the n held-out observations; delta = sum d_i; standard error se = sqrt(n * var(d, ddof = 1))
decisive_comparison.rule: preferred_model is named only when n >= 2, |delta| > 4 nats and |delta| > 2 se, and every assessment on both sides is content-bound (CORE-007); otherwise it is None and the comparison says why
decisive_comparison.class: C, from the elpd-difference practice of Vehtari, Gelman and Gabry (2017) and Sivula, Magnusson and Vehtari (2022): below about 4 nats, or within about 2 standard errors, a log-score difference does not separate models reliably, and the paired standard error is unreliable for small n
decisive_comparison.recorded: ModelScoreComparison gains n, standard_error and why

content_bound_assessment.rule: assess_predictive_observation takes split and calibration_table. Given both, the posterior must be the calibration half's likelihood by content (the study layer's INF-03 check), the held-out id must be the split's, and the observation must be the split's held-out observation of that key with that value; the assessment is then content_bound. Without them it is still made, and is not content_bound
content_bound_assessment.consequence: a comparison over any assessment that is not content_bound names no preferred model

prediction_domain.rule: GaussianObservation and PredictiveObservableSpec gain conditions (name -> Quantity). A routed prediction is compared with the calibration observations it is given: every declared prediction condition must be declared by every calibration observation and lie within their [min, max] on that name. Otherwise the prediction record is DOWNGRADED

reasons.PREDICTION_DOMAIN_NOT_DECLARED: no calibration observations were given, or the prediction or some calibration observation declares no conditions, or a prediction condition is not declared by every calibration observation (downgrade)
reasons.PREDICTION_OUTSIDE_CALIBRATED_CONDITIONS: a prediction condition lies outside the calibration's range of that condition (downgrade)

prediction_domain.range_tolerance: a value equal to an end of the range, to 1e-9 relative, is inside
prediction_domain.class: definitional; the box is per condition, which is stated as the residual (a joint region is not checked)

independence_recorded.rule: every routed predictive record states measurement_errors_assumed_independent = true; no claim changes

stated_residuals_before_implementation: CORE-006: the calibrated region is a per-condition box, not a joint region; the predictor callable is not bound to the calibrated model (only to its posterior digest)
CORE-007: a study that never passes split and calibration_table gets no preferred model rather than a checked one
CORE-012: correlated or systematic errors remain unrepresentable; the record states the assumption rather than testing it
amendments: recorded here as dated entries, never edited in place
